purpose_context: Today doSkillsRun unconditionally records every type:behavioral skills case as {passed:true, skipped:true} and never builds a client, so the already-tested runTriggerConformance grader is unreachable from the shipped CLI. This mission wires the CLI to the existing grader, fixes the MUSTER_BASE_URL vs MUSTER_ENDPOINT inconsistency, adds Ajv schema validation to the skills manifest, publishes the missing skills-trigger-taxonomy rubric so trigger-methodology citations point at a real, SHA-pinned source instead of a fabricated anchor, and closes muster#62's reproduced discrimination-control defect in the skills adapter's static case runner (a deleted control fixture no longer reads as a silent pass).
purpose_tldr: Make 'muster skills run' actually execute behavioral trigger-routing cases instead of silently marking them skipped, and fix the env-var/manifest seams around it.
